import pandas as pd, numpy as np
f=pd.read_csv('airlines/AS.csv', dtype=str); a=pd.read_csv('airports.csv')
print(a.to_string(index=False)); print('cancelled values',f.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict()); print('empty actual',f.actual_dep_utc.isna().sum(), (f.actual_dep_utc.fillna('').str.strip()=='').sum()); print('dupes all',f.duplicated().sum(),'flight_id',f.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
# normalize
f['cancelled_norm']=f['cancelled'].fillna('').str.strip().str.lower().eq('true')
f['actual_empty']=f.actual_dep_utc.fillna('').str.strip().eq('')
f['sched_dt_utc']=pd.to_datetime(f.date_utc.str.strip()+' '+f.sched_dep_utc.str.strip(), errors='coerce', utc=True)
f['actual_dt_utc']=pd.to_datetime(f.date_utc.str.strip()+' '+f.actual_dep_utc.fillna('').str.strip(), errors='coerce', utc=True)
# offsets
off=a.set_index('airport')['utc_offset_hours']; f['offset']=f.origin.map(off)
f['sched_local']=f.sched_dt_utc + pd.to_timedelta(f.offset, unit='h')
f['actual_local']=f.actual_dt_utc + pd.to_timedelta(f.offset, unit='h')
# reporting
m=(f.sched_local.dt.year==2025)&(f.sched_local.dt.month==2)
valid=m & ~f.cancelled_norm & ~f.actual_empty & f.actual_dt_utc.notna() & f.sched_dt_utc.notna()
x=f.loc[valid].copy(); x['delay_min']=(x.actual_local-x.sched_local).dt.total_seconds()/60; x['delayed']=x.delay_min>15
print('all February scheduled local',m.sum(),'valid completed',len(x),'delayed',x.delayed.sum(),'rate',round(100*x.delayed.mean(),1)); print(x[['flight_id','origin','sched_dt_utc','actual_dt_utc','sched_local','actual_local','delay_min','delayed']].to_string(index=False)); print('invalid feb',f.loc[m & ~valid,['flight_id','cancelled','actual_dep_utc','sched_dep_utc']].to_string(index=False))
